data.name: Ignition Point
data.detailed_description:
IGNITION POINT

Ignition Point is a competitive racing game focused on meaningful progression and accessible, skill-based driving.

Designed to sit between arcade and simulation, the game delivers a driving experience where cars have weight, braking matters, and consistency is rewarded, without overwhelming players with unnecessary complexity.

Whether you’re playing solo or online, Ignition Point is about learning, improving, and earning every step of your career.

A CAREER THAT MAKES SENSE

The career mode is built around dynamic events and leagues that unlock naturally as you progress.

  • Earn league points based on race performance

  • Qualify for Grand Prix events to advance leagues

  • Unlock new regions and racing disciplines over time

Progression is merit-based. Advancement comes from driving well, not from grinding or handouts.

Your garage matters as the game will not adapt to your garage, it is the other way around. Choosing which cars to buy, repair, and upgrade directly affects which events you can enter and how competitive you’ll be.

BUILD YOUR GARAGE

Ignition Point features both visual and performance customization.

  • Body kits, wings, paint and liveries

  • Mechanical upgrades such as engine, transmission, brakes and suspension

Cars are expensive and not every career starts with a perfect machine.

Players begin with a used car, and a dedicated used car market offers cheaper vehicles with reduced performance that require repairs. Smart decisions and gradual improvements can open doors to entire racing categories.

LEARN, PRACTICE, IMPROVE

The game includes tools designed to help players grow naturally:

  • Dedicated training mode

  • Sector-based practice with real-time feedback

  • Ghost racing against best laps

  • Optional racing line guidance available only in training

Ignition Point rewards players who focus on consistency and improvement.

ONLINE RACING & MATCHMAKING

Race online through competitive matchmaking with:

  • Category-based matchmaking

  • Track voting and veto system

  • Multi-race championships

Each race weekend features practice sessions, qualifying, and races with tire wear, fuel consumption, pit stops and vehicle damage.

Dedicated servers, crossplay support and Easy Anti-Cheat integration are planned.

MULTIPLE DISCIPLINES

Compete across multiple motorsport disciplines, including:

  • Touring & GT racing

  • Karting

  • Formula racing

  • Rally events

Each category offers a distinct feel while sharing the same core driving philosophy.

FEATURE HIGHLIGHT

• Accessible driving with real skill depth

• Merit-based career progression

• Meaningful garage and vehicle customization

• Used car market and repair system

• Competitive online matchmaking

• Multiple racing disciplines

• Training tools and ghost racing

• Dynamic weather and fast loading times

• Stylized, performance-friendly visuals

EARLY ACCESS & DEVELOPMENT

Ignition Point has been in development for over 2 years by a solo developer and is currently approaching a complete gameplay cycle.

The game is coming to Steam with Early Access under consideration. Content such as tracks, vehicles and customization options will expand during development, with a strong focus on quality, balance and player feedback.

data.short_description: Start as a rookie and rise to racing stardom in this skill‑driven arcade‑sim hybrid. Master diverse disciplines, conquer a deep career mode, and compete solo or online to carve your path to motorsport glory.
data.supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 8
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 2.9 GHz or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX650 or AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 3.6 GHz or AMD
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX970 or AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 8 MB available space
